Commentary.Commentary: Now then! The target is a one which can be achieved but the Afghans are a top bowling side so it will take some good batting. Will Masakadza win his last game or will Rashid's birthday turn out to be a special one? Join us in a while to find out.

The Zimbabwe bowling was poor to begin with! They had no answers to the carnage by the openers but did extremely well to pull things back after the Powerplay. Mpofu was the pick as he finished with the 4-fer. Tinotenda Mutombodzi was also very good during the middle overs and he along with the other spinners were the ones who applied the breaks.

The Afghan innings started superbly as their openers got off to a flyer, smashing a 83-run stand for the first wicket. But since then, it has been a downward slide for the Afghanistan side. They failed to stitch partnerships and got out to some poor shots too. The middle order failed miserably due to which, they fell way short of where they could have got at one stage.

Zimbabwe have done extremely well to pull back things and the game is evenly poised at the half way mark. Afghanistan though would be quite disappointed with their performance. They were all set at one stage to get close to the 180-run mark but they have fallen well short of what they once looked like they would achieve.

Slower full delivery outside off, Rashid makes room for himself to cut but misses. Rashid is surprised that why it is not given a wide by the umpire. Maybe his movement towards the off side prompted the umpire to not give it a wide. With that, AFGHANISTAN END UP WITH A SCORE OF 155 FOR 8.
Dawlat Zadran is in at number 10.

OUT! CAUGHT!  Excellent catching from Ainsley! He runs behind from point and takes an excellent catch going back. Good length delivery on off, Asghar looks to slog it away but gets an outside edge towards point where Ndlovu runs back and takes a magnificent catch. Excellent bowling from Mpofu. He has picked up four wickets in the innings and has stalled the run rate of the Afghans.
Full delivery on middle, Rashid comes down the track and plays it towards the off side for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Niazai is out of here trying to go for the big shots. Mpofu bowls a full delivery on middle, Niazai looks to slog it away but gets a top edge towards the long on region where Ryan Burl runs in and takes an excellent running catch. Three wickets for Mpofu.
Short ball on off, Rashid pulls it towards the leg side for a single.

SIX! What a shot from the birthday boy! Rashid comes down the track to this short delivery and slaps it away towards the deep mid-wicket region for a maximum. Rashid did not look like he got to the pitch of the ball but still managed to put it away. 150 up for Afghanistan.
Mpofu to bowl the final over of the innings.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
BOUNCER! It was bowled way above the head of Rashid who looked to pull but is unable to put any bat on it. The umpire gives it one for the over.
Full delivery on off, Niazai pushes it towards point for nothing. The debutant does not make use of the Free Hit here.

NO BALL! FOUR! Third No Ball bowled from Jarvis in this innings. Jarvis bowls a full delivery outside off, Fazal bends on his knees and lofts this over the point fielder for a boundary. Poor ball after the wicket here from Jarvis. A Free Hit will follow.
HERE WE HAVE THE BIRTHDAY BOY! Rashid Khan comes out to bat. Can he hit a few huge ones to end the Afghan innings on a high.

OUT! Gulbadin Naib is the latest casualty to go back to the pavilion! Afghanistan losing wickets in a heap here at Chattogram! Short delivery outside off, Naib looks to pull it but does not time it well. The ball goes off the upper half of his bat and goes towards Ndlovu at deep mid-wicket and he makes no mistake. Afghanistan losing their way here.
Slower short delivery outside off, Gulbadin looks to pull but is early into the shot and misses the ball completely.
Full delivery on middle, Fazal drives this to long on and takes a single.
Kyle Jarvis into the attack now!
A short one to end Williams' spell. Niazai pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Naib flicks this tossed up delivery on the pads to mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! BANG! Williams bowls one in the slot and Naib just lofts it cleanly over the bowler's head towards long on. The fielder there looked interested for a majority part only to watch it sail over him for a maximum. Useful runs this from Afghanistan's point of view.
Flatter one on off, Niazai pushes it to covers for a single.
Another one around off, pushed down the ground only for the bowler to field it in his followthrough.
Sean Williams is on for his final over.
Tossed up delivery on off, pushed to covers.

Loopy delivery on middle, Niazai pushes it to long on and takes another single. Only five runs have come off this over which is gold at this stage of the innings. The Rhodesians have made an excellent comeback to the innings here.
Another full delivery on middle, Naib pushes this towards long on and crosses over for a single.
Full delivery on middle and leg, Niazai flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Naib drives it towards mid on for a single.
Flat delivery on middle, Fazal flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Ainsley Ndlovu into the attack now.
Full delivery on off, Fazal pushes it to covers for nothing.
Full delivery on off, Niazai plays it towards the mid-wicket region for a single. He gets off the mark in T20Is with that.
Flatter delivery on middle, Niazai defends it off the back foot.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Fazal Niazai is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Zadran fails to make any impact in the game! Mutombodzi bowls a flighted delivery around off, Zadran looks to slog it away but gets an outside edge towards short third man where Madziva takes a simple catch. Afghanistan are losing track with regular wickets.
Full toss on middle, Naib flicks it towards deep mid-wicket to get off the mark with a single.
Full delivery on middle, Zadran defends it towards the off side for a single.
Tinotenda Mutombodzi is back into the attack.
Another slower ball around the pads, Zadran hops to work it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Gulbadin Naib is the new man in!

OUT! No Nabi heroics today as he holes out. Zimbabwe are right back into the game. Another slower bouncer, Nabi again goes for the pull but can't get the desired distance as he can't middle the pull. The ball goes high in the air towards fine leg where Jarvis moves to his left and settles under it to pouch it.
FOUR! Lucky boundary! Another back of length ball, a slower one. Nabi goes to pull but the ball takes the top edge and goes over the wicketkeeper and into the third man fence.
Back of a length ball around off, Zadran goes for the pull but mistimes the shot towards long on for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Zadran goes for the drive but misses.
Length ball around off, Najibullah goes back to cut but gets a bottom edge and the ball goes over the stumps and towards the keeper.
Mohammad Nabi is in for Afghans. He was in fine form in the last game.

OUT! TIMBER! Body blow here for the Afghans. Gurbaz was going great guns here. But his stay is cut short by Williams. Sean bowls a tossed up delivery on the stumps and seeing this, Gurbaz's eyes lit up. He dances down the track but fails to get to the pitch of the delivery and the ball misses his swing only to disturb the furniture behind. Three quick wickets and Zimbabwe are crawling their way back in the game.
Zadran rocks on the back foot on this flatter one and punches it to covers for a single.
FREE HIT! Nothing much on the Free Hit here. Williams bowls one on the stumps and Gurbaz eases this out to covers for a single.

NO ball! Oh on earth what has Williams done here. He bowls one flatter on middle and Gurbaz goes for a drive only to hit it uppishly to the man at covers. Hang on! Williams has overstepped and that means there will be a Free Hit on the next ball.
FOUR! Innovation there from Gurbaz. Williams bowls one outside off, and Gurbaz is quick to bring out the reverse sweep and places it in between square leg and short third man fielder for a boundary.
Fuller one on the pads, Zadran flicks it to short fine leg for a single.
Flatter one on off, lofted by Gurbaz to long on  but the ball just falls short of the fielder there. A single taken.
Najibullah Zadran is the new man in for the Afghans. Sean Williams is back for his 3rd over.

OUT! LBW! That is plumb and Shafiqullah has to go. Two quick wickets for Zimbabwe here and that is exactly what the Rhodesians need to get back into the game. Mpofu bowls a slower delivery on middle, Shafiqullah looks to slog it away but misses. He is hit on the back pad and the umpire gives it out. Shafiqullah decides to take the review after consulting with his partner. The replays roll in and it shows three reds on the Hawk Eye. Shafiqullah has to make the long walk back to the pavilion.
Shafiqullah has been given out LBW but after consulting the non-striker, he has gone for the DRS. That looks plumb. Let's see what the replays show.
BOUNCER! Good one at that! Shafiqullah looks to hook it but misses the ball completely.
Another short delivery on middle, Gurbaz pulls it towards the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Nicely played! Short delivery on middle, Gurbaz moves towards the leg side and pulls it nicely towards the square leg region for a boundary. The fielder at deep square leg runs after it to stop it from going into the fence but in vain.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FIFTY! First fifty for him in T20Is! It has been an excellent innings from him so far and would look to continue here. Good length delivery on middle, Rahmanullah flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Chris Mpofu is back into the attack!
Played to the point region by the batsman.

SIX! Shafiqullah is looking to attack the spinners here. Flighted delivery outside off, Shafiqullah reaches for it and lofts this beautifully over the long off fence for another maximum. Excellent shot this.
Full delivery on middle, Shafiqullah looks to sweep but it goes off the inside half towards the leg side. The batters take a couple.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.
Full delivery on middle, Shafiqullah plays a paddle sweep towards short fine leg.
FOUR! Good shot from Shafiqullah! Mutombodzi bowls a flighted delivery outside off, Shafiqullah leans forward and plays a nice lofted shot over the extra cover fielder for a boundary.
Flatter one on off, defended back to the bowler.

IN THE AIR... AND ANOTHER DROP! Shafiqullah gets a life. He goes for the slog sweep on the flighted ball but fails to get under the ball. In the end he gets a top edge that goes towards deep mid-wicket where the fielder runs forward to take the catch. But his timing is not right. He dives only to miss it and concede a single in the end. How costly this would be? Zimbabwe need to hold on to these chances if they are to make an impact here.
Tossed up on middle, Shafiqullah works it to mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Shafiqullah defends this flatter one off the back foot.
Tossed up delivery around off, Gurbaz pushes it to off side for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Gurbaz pushes it back to the bowler.

A googly around off, Shafiqullah fails to read it and attempts to defend it towards the off side. The ball goes through the bat and pad but just misses the off stump. A successful over comes to an end for Zimbabwe.
Short ball on off, Gurbaz plays it to mid off and takes a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shafiqullah is the new batsman in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally, finally a wicket for the Rhodesians. It took a long time for them. Mutombodzi bowls a flighted delivery on middle, Zazai gets a top edge while attempting to play a slog sweep and it goes way up in the air towards short third man where Mutumbami takes a simple catch. These two were taking the game away from the Zimbabweans. They have broken the partnership now and would look to get back in the game.
Full delivery on off, Rahmanullah pushes it to long off and crosses over for a single.
Full delivery on the legs, Hazratullah flicks it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Tinotenda Mutombodzi comes into the attack!
Shortish ball on the pads, Zazai works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Yorker length around off, Gurbaz jams it towards cover for a single.
In the channel outside off this time, this is slower ball. Gurbaz goes for the drive but can't get bat on ball as he is done with the pace.

In the air.. and dropped! How costly will it be? Chakabva, on his birthday, has made a mess of one of the simplest of chances at deep mid-wicket and on top of that he also concedes a boundary. This is around off, slightly shorter, Gurbaz goes to pull again but the ball hits high on his bat and balloons high in the air. The ball goes straight to Chakabva who can't hold on. Zimbabwe are in a position where they can't put down chances like these if they want to crawl back in the game.
Another slower ball, this was full toss around off, Gurbaz strokes it straight to cover.
Slower bumper to begin the over. Gurbaz ducks under it.
Neville Madziva into the attack now!
Flatter one around off, tucked towards point for a run. 13 runs from the over.
Slightly short again, and outside off, Zazai pushes it towards point for a single.
A loopy one around off, pushed towards mid off.
Flatter one this time,  Gurbaz works it towards the off side to take a single.
SIX! Now a six. Another shortish length ball, Gurbaz stays rooted in his crease and lifts it high in the air towards mid-wicket. It has gone too high but it has distance as well.
FOUR! Welcome to the attack Mr Burl says Gurbaz. Burl lands it slightly short around off, Gurbaz goes back and hammers it in the gap between mid-wicket and long on. The ball goes into the fence.
Ryan Burl to bowl now. Can he break the opening stand?
Short delivery on middle, Zazai defends it off the back foot back towards the bowler. Good over for Zimbabwe as only seven runs came off it.

SIX! Poor delivery from Williams. Bowls a rank long hop on middle, Zazai stands back and pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket for a maximum. This is poor stuff from Zimbabwe. They are just giving away easy runs to Afghanistan and the game is quickly moving out of hand here for them.
Floated delivery around off, Gurbaz drives it towards covers for a single. The batters think of a couple but is not there.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Flighted delivery on middle, Gurbaz flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter delivery on middle, Gurbaz defends it off the back foot.
Sean Williams is back on!

FREE HIT! Gurbaz does not make use of the Free Hit! Short ball on middle, Gurbaz pulls it towards the leg side for a single. 55 runs have come in the Powerplay. Excellent one for Afghanistan as they have laid the foundation for the batters to come to set a big total.

NO BALL! Jarvis oversteps, bowls a slower delivery on middle,  Rahmanullah looks to swing but misses the ball completely. OHH! The replays roll in and it shows that Jarvis had his some part of the leg behind the crease. He will feel unlucky as a Free Hit will be awarded off the next ball.
Short ball on off, Hazratullah rocks back and pulls it nicely towards deep square leg for another single.
Good length delivery on middle, Rahmanullah defends it off the back foot towards the off side for a quick single.
Slower delivery on middle, Hazratullah defends it towards the off side for a single.
Good length delivery on middle, Hazratullah looks to slog it away but again gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Good length delivery on the legs, Hazratullah looks to flick it but gets an inside edge and hits him on the box. It is looking really painful for Zazai out there and he is lying down on the ground. He is taking his time out there to get back into groove.
Floated delivery on middle, Zazai plays it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single. 50 up for Afghanistan in quick time.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Full delivery on the legs, Hazratullah sweeps it fine towards the fine leg region for a boundary. Poor bowling this from Ndlovu. He is giving away easy runs here.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads.
Flighted delivery on middle, Gurbaz flicks it towards the leg side for a single.

SIX! Poor bowling from Ndlovu! It is a short delivery on leg, Rahmanullah rocks back and pulls it nicely towards the deep mid-wicket fence for the fourth six of the game. Zimbabwe are bowling too short here and Afghanistan are making full use of it.
Ainsley Ndlovu is back on!
Zazai flicks this length ball off his pads towards the leg side. Huge over from Afghanistan's point of view.
FOUR! Another short one and Zazai pulls only to get  top edge. Zazai is late into pull and the top edge runs down to fine leg for another boundary.
Short and on middle, Zazai pulls but straight to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Chris corrects his line and bowls it wide of off. Zazai stands on the back foot and cuts it powerfully through point for a boundary. Fireworks from the Afghan openers.

FOUR BYES! Ohh! That is like rubbing salt on the wound. Mpofu bowls an excellent ball. He bowls it outside off and brings the ball in with the angle only to miss the wild swing of Zazai. The ball goes  just past the off pole. The ball just bounces in front of the diving Brendan Taylor behind the wicket who fails to collect it and the ball runs down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length around off, Gurbaz pulls but fails to get underneath the ball and gets it of the inside half towards square leg. A single taken.
Chris Mpofu into the attack.
Full delivery on middle, Gurbaz flicks it down the leg side for a single.

SIX! Excellent shot from Gurbaz! Flighted delivery on leg, Gurbaz goes down on his knees and sweeps it towards the deep fine leg region for the third maximum of the innings. Afghanistan are off to a good start here.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads.

Full delivery on middle, Gurbaz looks to flick but gets an edge towards fine leg for a single. The short fine leg fielder throws it at the stumps at the non-striker's end but misses. The ball goes towards mid off where the fielder fumbles and it rolls behind him where the fielder from long on cleans it up. The batter get an extra run.
Short delivery on off, Gurbaz defends it towards mid off.
Full delivery on middle, Rahmanunullah defends it back to the bowler.
Sean Williams comes into the attack!
Good length delivery on leg, Zazai looks to flick but misses. The ball goes on to hit him on the pads. 14 runs from the over.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Gurbaz cuts it to backward point for a single.
SIX! Gurbaz joins into the act now! Short delivery on middle, Gurbaz rocks back and pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for another maximum. Excellent start this for Afghanistan.

Good length delivery outside off, Zazai looks to loft it away but gets a leading edge towards third man. The fielder uns ahead from deep third man and dives to catch but is unable to get to it. The batsmen cross ends.

SIX! Short delivery on middle, Zazai plays a terrific pull shot over the mid-wicket fence. Excellent shot from Zazai. First six of the game. It made a cracking sound of the bat and it went deep into the crowd.
Good length delivery on the legs, Hazratullah looks to flick but misses and it goes on to hit the pads.
Kyle Jarvis to bowl from the other end.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads. A good start from Ndlovu and Zimbabwe.
Flighted delivery on middle, Rahmanullah looks to sweep but gets a leading edge towards the fine leg region and the batters take a couple.
Full delivery on middle, Gurbaz defends it to the off side.
Flighted delivery on middle, Gurbaz looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. There was an appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire.
Flatter delivery on middle, Rahmanullah defends it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Starts with a short delivery outside off,  Gurbaz cuts it but straight to cover.
We are all set to begin! Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Hazratullah Zazai make their way out to the middle along with the Zimbabwean players. Ainsley Ndlovu will start the proceedings for the Rhodesians.

Hamilton says that he would've loved to play the finals but it is still an important game and adds that the side is ready to go. On being asked about what is riding this game, Masakadza says that he would want to end the series on a high and would want to register their first win against the Afghans.

Rashid says it looks a good wicket and they will bat first. In the last game there were some issues during the run chase. Rashid says that the side is not taking it as a dead rubber. He adds that they will want to continue doing well going into the finals. Informs that they have 3 changes.

PITCH REPORT - Conditions are pretty similar to the last game. The same pitch was used in the last game of the series as well. The pitch has been watered but still looks dry. We can get some inconsistent bounce due to the dry surface. Not a lot of grass on the surface. Win the toss and put a decent total on the board he recommends.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Hazratullah Zazai, Shafiqullah (IN FOR NAJEEB TARAKAI), Asghar Afghan, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Gulbadin Naib, Fazal Niazai (IN FOR KARIM JANAT), Rashid Khan (C), Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Dawlat Zadran (IN FOR FAREED AHMAD)

Zimbabwe (Unchanged Playing XI) - Brendan Taylor (WK), Hamilton Masakadza (C), Sean Williams, Regis Chakabva, Tinotenda Mutombodzi, Ryan Burl, Richmond Mutumbami, Neville Madziva, Kyle Jarvis, Ainsley Ndlovu, Chris Mpofu
TOSS - It is toss time in Chattogram, both the captains are out there and up goes the coin. It lands in Afghanistan's favour and they have chosen to bat.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 5th match of the tri-series between Bangladesh, Afghanistan and Zimbabwe. Zimbabwe, have not turned up at all in this series losing all their matches so far. This is their skipper Hamilton Masakadza's last match in Zimbabwean colors and will look to end on a high with a win. A win here though will be nothing but a consolation and it will be a good end to their skipper's career. Afghanistan, on the other hand, are on a roll, winning the two matches that they have played so far. They are already into the finals but will want to continue their winning momentum. It is their superstar, Rashid Khan's 21st birthday and a win here will be a good present for him. Is there a surprise in store? Stay tuned to find out.
